task.title: Configure incoming webhooks in Slack
task.shortdesc: To prepare Slack for integration with the Hybrid Cloud Console, you must configure incoming webhooks in Slack.

ul.li: You have owner or admin permissions to the Slack instance where you want to add incoming webhooks.
You have App Manager permissions to add Slack apps to a channel.
You have a Slack channel or user to receive notifications.

substep.cmd: Go to the Slack API web page and click the Create your Slack app button. This opens the Create an app dialog.
Select From scratch to use the Slack configuration UI to create your app.
Enter a name for your app and select the workspace where you want to receive notifications.

info.note: If you see a message that administrator approval is required, you can request approval in the next step.

substep.cmd: Click Create App to finish creating the Slack app.
Under the Features heading in the navigation panel, click Incoming Webhooks.
Toggle the Activate Incoming Webhooks switch to On.

Click the Request to Add New Webhook button. If required, enter a message to your administrators to grant access to your app and click Submit Request. A success message confirms you have configured this correctly.
Under Settings in the navigation panel, click Install App.
In the Install App section, click the Install to workspace button.
Select the channel where you want your Slack app to post notifications, or select a user to send notifications to as direct messages.

step.cmd: Optional: Configure how your Hybrid Cloud Console notifications appear in Slack:

substep.cmd: Under Settings in the navigation panel, click Basic Information.
Edit your app name, description, icon, and background color as desired.
Click the Copy button next to the webhook URL. You will use the URL to set up the integration in the Hybrid Cloud Console in .

ul.li: Open the Slack channel or user you selected during configuration, and check for a message confirming you have added the integration.
